fc_start_stop_reward_scope: The fixed one-cycle start-stop settlement remains in the complete physical ledger but is excluded from the learning reward because the current Actor does not control the physical on/off event. Action-dependent shutdown transient degradation remains included.
battery_equivalent_hydrogen_sign: Signed CNY ledger term: discharge is positive cost, charge is negative credit. With gamma=1 and fixed eta_fc_avg, its episode sum is determined by net SOC change.
terminal_soc_rule: Apply the terminal SOC penalty only on successful full-voyage completion; target SOC is 0.5.
training_selection: fixed Train voyage parent_005_seg01; 9258 one-second intervals; reset at t=0 with SOC=0.6
evaluation_protocol: Deterministic fixed parent_005_seg01 every 20 episodes and full Validation8 every 100 episodes
